description.en: A human-in-the-loop spec drift firewall for AI coding. Turns duplicate routes, stale generated artifacts, and unapproved contracts into a deterministic PASS/FAIL before review or merge. No LLM in the gate. No auto-merge. Extracted from SciPal (https://github.com/williamchen520/scipal-public).
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码的人工审批契约门禁：把重复路由、过期生成物和未批准契约变成确定性的 PASS/FAIL。门禁内不调用 LLM，不自动合并。抽取自 SciPal（https://github.com/williamchen520/scipal-public）。

description.en: Stop shipping code that passes tests but silently drifts from the spec a human approved. Deterministic spec gate: no LLM, no auto-merge, explicit expiring exceptions. Built from SciPal, an auditable biomedical RAG platform.
description.zh: 阻止“测试通过但已偏离人工批准规范”的代码进入合并。确定性规范门禁：门禁内无 LLM、不自动合并、例外必须精确且过期失效。抽取自可审计生物医学 RAG 平台 SciPal。
